verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead doubled as spend scaled up.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Meta delivered 127 leads at an average cost of $6.19 per lead — a solid baseline. However, in the most recent 7 days, spend surged 139.7% while leads grew only 16%, causing cost per lead to spike 106.64% against the prior 7-day period. The primary campaign driving that spend is being reviewed this week to tighten targeting and bring efficiency back in line. Several planned program elements — including search campaigns, landing pages, and lead intake automation — remain in progress and their completion will broaden lead sources and reduce reliance on a single campaign. Next period, the focus is stabilising cost per lead while those additional channels come online.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead nearly doubled in the last 7 days as budget on the primary campaign scaled faster than conversion efficiency could keep pace with.
watch_item.fix: Targeting on that campaign is being tightened this week and daily spend is being moderated until efficiency recovers.
